## Algebra

[Irreducible polynomials over finite fields](notes/irreducible-polynomials.qmd)

Why $x^{p^n}-x$ is the product of the monic irreducible polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_p$ whose degrees divide $n$, and how Möbius inversion gives an exact formula for their number.
